The trust gap

In Dubai, good work isn't enough — customers can't tell who to trust

Listings are full of unverified names, recycled photos, and reviews nobody can confirm. Honest businesses get lumped in with the rest, and customers default to whoever is cheapest. Quvera fixes the signal.

🎭
Anyone can claim anythingNo licence check, no team verification — a fake profile looks the same as a real, licensed company.
⭐
Reviews you can't trustBought ratings and anonymous reviews make star counts almost meaningless to a serious buyer.
💸
A race to the bottomWith no way to prove quality, customers pick on price — and quality businesses lose work they earned.
The difference

The 3-Shield Verification System

Three independent layers of proof — not a self-declared badge. Each shield is checked against real documents and shown on your public profile for customers to see.

🛡️
Shield 1

Trust Score

  • ✓ A single 0–100 score built from verification, reviews, ratings and profile completeness
  • ✓ Tier ladder: Building → Verified → Trusted → Elite
  • ✓ Earned over time — it can't be bought
🛡️
Shield 2

Team — EID Verified

  • ✓ Your real team members verified against Emirates ID
  • ✓ Customers see exactly who they're dealing with
  • ✓ Expiry-aware — verification stays current, not one-time
🛡️
Shield 3

Verified Documents

  • ✓ Trade Licence, owner ID, and an 8-document verification layer
  • ✓ Reviewed by the Quvera team against official records
  • ✓ A live verification % customers can read at a glance

Questions

Good to know

Is it really free to start?+
Yes. A Free Verified Listing costs AED 0, and every paid plan begins with a 30-day Launch Plan that unlocks all features — no card required to start.
What does "verified" actually mean?+
Your trade licence and documents are reviewed by the Quvera team against official records, and your team is verified against Emirates ID. Customers see the result as your three shields — they're not self-declared badges.
How do leads reach me?+
When a customer submits an enquiry on your profile, you receive their name, phone, area and budget by email and WhatsApp, and the lead appears in your Lead Hub to manage and reply.
Can I keep my existing reviews and reputation?+
Your Quvera reputation is built here through verified reviews and completed work. The more you do on the platform, the stronger your trust score becomes over time.
What happens after the 30-day Launch Plan?+
You choose the plan that fits — including staying on the Free Verified Listing. Nothing is charged automatically without you selecting a paid plan.
